definitions.gloss: food expenses; food costs; food budget
definitions.explanation: The amount of money spent on food, whether for a household, individual, or organization. A common category in personal budgeting and household economics.

examples.japanese: {食費|しょくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}する→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧。
⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{食費|しょくひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Food expenses were higher this month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めて→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{食費|しょくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧{三万円|さんまんえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Since I started living alone, I've been trying to keep my food budget under 30,000 yen a month.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the most common household expense categories. Often discussed alongside other expense types like ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧ (rent), ⟦{光熱費|こうねつひ}→光熱費：08244_kounetsuhi⟧ (utility bills), and ⟦{交通費|こうつうひ}→交通費：03056_koutsuuhi⟧ (transportation costs).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食費|しょくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}する→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧ (to save on food expenses)
- {食費|しょくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧ (to keep food costs down)
- ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食費|しょくひ} (monthly food expenses)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{生活費|せいかつひ}→生活費：19424_seikatsuhi⟧: living expenses — the broader category that includes food, housing, and other costs
- {外食費|がいしょくひ}: dining-out expenses — money spent specifically on eating out
